Narrowest supported role: local diagnostic fidelity of the embedded first-period predictor on this frozen structure. No general reliability, screening, or automatic-rejection authority follows. All four full-task forecasts unresolved; predicted order abstained while actual holding-speed order resolved (-1 slower than -0 by 0.01035 m/s) → ordering_verdict unresolved, resolved coverage 0.0, conditional accuracy undefined. An abstained forecast does not demonstrate execution-ordering usefulness.

Full-task outcomes on frozen structure a6099... (near 0.16 m, far 0.11 m, section_scale 0.95, compliant; terminal_tip_speed_weight 0.05). Candidate -0 (holding 0.075) LOST joint reach+holding: terminal reach passed 0.002835 m, holding position passed 0.002906 m, holding speed 0.023286 m/s > 0.02. Candidate -1 (0.15) PRESERVED joint acceptance: terminal 0.002692 m, holding position 0.002746 m, holding speed 0.012939 m/s. Both report 35/35 deadline_misses and mean complete update ~8.51 s at 0.01 s period (real_time_demonstrated false) — raw termination/timing measures, distinct from any controller policy stop; no real-time, continuous-time, or hardware claim supported. Against the selected incumbent both candidates deteriorate holding error and speed at frozen tolerances; -1 is a physical tradeoff with better terminal error (-5.58e-6 m), an improvement appearing only versus the earlier failing baseline.

Hypothesis rejected. The planned pointwise separation (.075 passes, .15 fails) was contradicted at both points. Scope: .075 failing is consistent with some boundary within (0.05, 0.15]; .15 passing rejects only the stated high-point failure. This falsifies no whole interval, validates no continuous threshold or monotonic law, and is an observation, not a mechanism; a two-point batch describes only the tested candidates, so no range-wide claim of dominant cause or ineffectiveness is made. Zero force-bound violations does not exclude legal near-bound input.

Candidate disposition: retain the accepted .05/.05 incumbent; no promotion. M4 closed, M5 overall open. Next action finish; next route stop; no further execution authorized. Availability of further observations is unverified for any unread inventory subset."

That's good, ~470 words. Now next_research fields.

selected_candidate: "baseline". Hmm — but is that right? The schema description: "baseline, candidate, none; for a supplied completed batch, an exact evaluated candidate_id may be selected." So selected_candidate="baseline" is valid, paired with retain_baseline. Good.
